evidence_summary: Replay log shows three quick-mode collection creates carrying top-level shardsNum=0/-1/65535 all returning HTTP 200 code=0, with no FAILED/assertion lines and no post-create describe proving the shard value was consumed.
rationale: The payload pattern matches documented by-design behavior (maintainer issue 50351: REST v2 create does not consume top-level shardsNum and silently ignores it, the field is consumed via params.shardsNum), so the 200 responses evidence a default-shards create with an ignored field rather than acceptance of an invalid shard count, c2 (65535) does not even violate the stated shardsNum>=1 assertion, and with the constraint never exercised on its consumed path plus only a single replay-capture script the claimed param_validation defect is not established.
